road_binding.module: wms.core.road (RoadGeometry, MERGE_ORIGINAL, current_road, bind_road, road_scope, load_road, road_from_descriptor, map_default, geometry_digest_of)
road_binding.rule: set WMS_MAP_SPEC or COOPMWM_MAP_SPEC to the wz3to2 MAP_SPEC.json in EVERY training / eval / planning process (one map per process; bind_road refuses rebinding); a process where N1's map_descriptor.bind ran is followed too; unset = the original on-ramp merge map. With N1 merged, load_road uses tools.coopmwm.map_descriptor.load (repo root on PYTHONPATH); real N1 geometry == stub geometry (tested).
road_binding.what_changes_on_wz3to2: exit at 1379.44; entry process lane starts / entrance-edge ends / speed caps; closing-lane cars may change 2->1 along the whole approach (mobil logits, physical envelope, lane_v5 mask); the first-passage merge law owns only the lane-end zone [0,75.44], upstream closing-lane cars use the lane_v5 merge head. Lane-end-zone modules (merge_pivot/merge_core/ramp_speed_adapt/forced window), sections and RSU field cells are unchanged by construction (same frame).

signatures.load: load(checkpoint=None, *, map_spec=None, device='cpu', config='configs/c4_wm_loop14_r16_ft.toml', max_rows=64, seed=101) -> Handle
signatures.evaluate: evaluate(handle, state, actions, *, K=8, H=300.0, seed=0, trace=None) -> {action_id: [J_1..J_K]}

load_kwargs.checkpoint: <WM-E wz3to2 fine-tuned wm_s.pt with its physics.json; None = fresh weights, DRY RUNS ONLY (handle.meta['trained'] is False)>
load_kwargs.map_spec: <wz3to2 MAP_SPEC.json or None if WMS_MAP_SPEC/COOPMWM_MAP_SPEC is set>
load_kwargs.device: cuda on gpuA/gpuR, cpu for tests
load_kwargs.max_rows: action x draw rows per batched rollout

semantics.observe: RSU-observable only: moment['cavs'] CAV self-states {id, edge, lane, x (global) | pos (lane position), v[, length]}; optional moment['vehicles'] CAV-detected neighbours (same format + is_cav); optional moment['counter'] [2,30] RSU entrance counts (10 s bins newest first; 0 = through lanes, 1 = closing lane) -> Poisson entries. Projection: up lane 2/1/0 -> WM 0/1/2, wz lane 1/0 -> WM 0/1, s = x - 2620.56. No world labels are read. moment['map'] must equal the road. Rows on the drop's internal junction lane ':n1_0_i' (x 2696-2704) project onto the downstream lane i (global x kept).
semantics.evaluate: J_k = team delay veh-s over [t0, t0+H): sum_t 0.5 s * sum_present max(0, 1 - v/31.29) of the predicted road vehicles (no source-waiting term unless an entry process is built from moment['counter']; then entrants count while on road). CRN: the WM rollout's lane-sampling uniforms for draw k are generated from sha256(seed, k, state digest) and shared by every action of the call; deterministic and repeatable (tested). Members (role 'hold'): a = clip((v_w - v)/1 s, -dmax, amax) for t in [start_s, start_s + hold_s) until the member passes release_x (global x) or the anchor passes anchor_release_x; WM native acceleration before/after; member lanes held except the WM first-passage merge in the lane-end zone (delegated). Non-member CAVs are native drivers (WM HDV law). Unknown member id / duplicate action ids / non-finite J raise wms.planapi.WMContractError.
semantics.cost: CPU fresh model: ~0.5 s per rollout step for 6 rows x 27 vehicles (4 threads); WM-C's ~1,300-1,600 action-draws x H=300 s per moment needs the GPU (batched rows, max_rows).

prog.module: wms.planapi_prog (ProgramController subclasses HoldSpeedController; built only when an action has a 'prog' member)
prog.semantics: lcm_core.Arm._prog (48aaae38) in the WM frame, decided at whole seconds and executed 1 s: releases (absent, start_s+hold_s, release_x, release_on_partner_merge partner off the closing lane / unobserved, merger left lane 0 or x >= fallback_x default drop-15); lane program lc_target (SUMO up index) from lc_from s / lc_from_x while x < lc_giveup_x (default drop-300), one lane per step when legal and GAPRULE secure (speed_gap_safe); speed kinds hold / track (kp, kv, track_off, settle_gap) / match (target lane mean speed within 100 m until the change) / accel, clipped [-dmax, amax], commanded speed capped at 31.29; members must be observed CAVs; unknown params / speed kinds / lanes raise WMContractError.
limitations: tau APPROXIMATED: only the member's native (uncommanded) acceleration uses IDM with time headway tau (WM default IDM otherwise); SUMO's tau-dependent safe-speed cap on commanded speeds (speedMode 27) is not modelled
lc_mode recorded, not interpreted (513 assumed: only programmed changes)
after release / before start: WM native acceleration, lane held except the lane-end first-passage merge (SUMO restores native lane changes)
lane changes instantaneous within one 0.5 s step; settled 'track' without v_w = native

data_pipeline.rollout_format: traffic_shepherd.c4.recorder episode dirs (episode.npz schema c4_sumo_episode/1, model frame, K=512) recorded with N1's map runtime installed; recorder.map_meta() stamps meta_json map / map_descriptor_sha256 / road_digest / k_slots when the road is bound. Required meta: seed, demand_vph, penetration, warmup_s (+ map). Controllers native/direct only unless --allow-designed. WM-B used it for arms native, mappo_u0, coop_mappo_u0, coop_native (E:/agent-work/_sol/WMB_DATA_SHARDS.md).
data_pipeline.converter_cli: COOPMWM_MAP_SPEC=<wz3to2 MAP_SPEC.json> python -m wms.data.c4_episodes --episodes <collect dirs> --out <NEW empty dir> --map-spec <wz3to2 MAP_SPEC.json> [--val-frac 0.2 --split-seed 0]
data_pipeline.manifest: C4_EPISODES_MANIFEST.json schema wms_c4_episode_source/1 + map, road (record), road_digest; entries carry map, map_descriptor_sha256; arrays unchanged (veh_kin [T,K,7], counter [T,2,30] entrance 1 = closing-lane insertions, ...).
data_pipeline.loader_checks: read_source_manifest refuses: a source whose map != process road; a non-original source whose road GEOMETRY (geometry_digest_of(manifest['road'])) != the process road's (provenance/projection fields ignored, so WM-B's packs from 10a8f0b3 stay valid).
data_pipeline.seed_guard: wms.data.map_guard.check_train_seed: wz3to2 WM train/val = 989100-989199 ONLY; refused: 989000-989099 (PLANGEN2), 989200-989599 (clean4 TRAIN incl. WM-D label worlds), 989600-989699 (held-out), 964000-964199, 962xxx, 977xxx, anything else. Evaluation/qualification tapes are read through WM-D's own path.
